lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five identifiable vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin, with inter-blob spatial distance increasing towards the caudal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with primary circular nodes to create a semi-regular grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features on the upper flank defined by sharp vertical intensity gradients, showing light-valued dorsal edges and shadowed ventral margins.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small-diameter luminance spots on the visible pectoral fin surface; presence of a distinct elongated silhouette positioned on the dorsal-cranial region.
